phenotypes.label: AI-forward consulting / managed service
phenotypes.description: Consulting, regulatory, implementation, or ops delivered as service with AI core

phenotypes.description: Payments, wallets, underwriting, liability products where AI changes the SKU

phenotypes.label: Research / terminal / intelligence product
phenotypes.description: Bloomberg-style terminals, equity/healthcare research agents, market intelligence

phenotypes.label: Robotics / embodied / teleoperation
phenotypes.description: Drones, robots, sensing meshes, teleop, model-hardware co-design

phenotypes.description: Trials, lab workflows, drug discovery, clinical AI imaging ops

phenotypes.label: Compliance / regulatory / gov automation
phenotypes.description: SOX, FDA, audit controls, defense supply chain, gov-critical workflows

phenotypes.label: Consumer / prosumer AI application
phenotypes.description: End-user apps, games, personal finance, creative tools

phenotypes.label: Open-source core + commercial layer
phenotypes.description: OSS agent frameworks or tools with hosted/enterprise monetization

phenotypes.label: Agent Context Infrastructure
phenotypes.description: API/service layer that prepares external data sources (system logs, web content, documents, telemetry) for agent consumption by compressing, structuring, enriching, or summarizing into token-efficient, semantically dense formats. Solves the 'context explosion' problem: agents need rich operational or domain context but can't ingest raw verbose data due to token limits and cost. Examples: log compression for agent observability, realtime web crawling/extraction APIs, document-to-context pipelines.

phenotypes.label: AI-Native Prime Contractor
phenotypes.description: Full-stack operational entity (not just software) that uses AI to automate end-to-end execution of complex, multi-party, compliance-heavy contracts in regulated industries (defense, construction, public infrastructure). Combines AI workflow automation, capital, supplier networks, and operational execution to act as a next-generation prime contractor or general contractor. AI handles procurement, compliance, supplier coordination, production tracking, and delivery logistics. Distinct from vertical SaaS because they take contractual responsibility and execute the work, not just provide tools.

phenotypes.label: AI-Native Service Provider (Outcome-Based)
phenotypes.description: Companies that use AI to deliver traditional services (operations, claims recovery, contracting) at software-like margins but sell outcomes/results rather than software seats. They take contractual/financial responsibility for end-to-end processes and use AI agents to execute the work autonomously. Revenue models are service-based (contingency, per-contract, managed service) not SaaS subscriptions. Distinct from vertical SaaS because they ARE the service provider, not the software vendor enabling the service.

phenotypes.label: AI-enabled physical infrastructure
phenotypes.description: Companies building physical hardware/infrastructure (energy, transportation, manufacturing) where AI accelerates design optimization, manufacturing precision, and autonomous operational control. AI is enabler rather than product - core value is the physical system itself, but AI dramatically improves R&D cycles, production efficiency, and system performance. Includes robotics, but also nuclear reactors, aviation networks, advanced manufacturing equipment, etc.

phenotypes.label: AI-native research labs
phenotypes.description: Organizations using agentic AI workflows to automate scientific research and discovery processes. Meta-level AI application: AI discovering better AI (novel architectures, optimizers, training methods) or accelerating research in other domains. Distinct from research tools (which assist human researchers) - these are AI-first labs where agents conduct primary research with minimal human intervention.

phenotypes.label: Marketplace / exchange / liquidity network
phenotypes.description: Two-sided venues: exchanges, perps, private-market liquidity, investor matching — not selling insurance or a bank SKU
